name: Mossback
blurb: Tip 3 logs to open the way.
notes: 1-2 · Mossback. Teach: touching moves things. About 80 seconds. Nothing here is deadly. Map: 1720px = 9,000pt (x scale 5.23); y maps the map's 14-230 band onto 14-350. Every gate sits on the same screen as the log that works it, and creaks right up into the roof when it opens, so an open gate never looks like a wall.

rects.note: Beat 05: the mound the second pebble rests on. Its far edge is sharp, so a pushed pebble drops straight off it onto log 2's high end.

seesaws.note: Beat 02: landing on the high end tips it, and gate 1 creaks up in full view.
Beat 05: the pebble rolls off the mound onto this log's high end, tucked under the edge, and tips it.
Beat 07: two logs. The left one is the wrong one and just bounces you.

gates.note: Beat 06: gate 2 drifts shut over 3s, so the player has to commit to a dive.

pebbles.note: beat 01: bumping it rolls it ahead

seeds.note: beat 03: grabbing it tips the log
beat 06: low, behind the closing gate
Beat 08: the skill seed, low just past the right log's raised end. Puff only flies forward, so it's a steep dive past the end rather than a hollow under it.

blooms.note: beat 04: gates you've opened stay open
